name: Varoom
description: Varoom, the Single-Cyl Pokémon. Able to evolve into Revavroom. A Steel and Poison type.
pokedex_entries: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.
The steel section is Varoom's actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.
